What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. This policy applies only to screeningclearing.com — the Screening Clearing mobile app does not use cookies.

Cookies we use

Strictly necessary cookies — Required for the site to function. No consent needed.

Statistics cookies (Google Analytics 4) — Used to understand how visitors use this website. Only enabled with your consent. No personal health data is collected.
